info.description: Open-weight 74B-parameter (9B active) vision-language model from NVIDIA under the OpenMDW-1.1 license, built for running everyday agentic tasks locally (tool calling, web browsing, terminal use). Mamba-2-Transformer hybrid LatentMoE with a C-RADIO v4-H vision encoder; the 24GB release uses native 2-bit quantization, with GGUF and BF16 variants also published. Accepts text, images and video and returns text; context up to 256K tokens shared by prompt and response. Reasoning is toggled with the chat template (enable_thinking). No hosted NVIDIA API endpoint or official token price found.

zh.description: NVIDIA 开放权重的视觉语言模型，总参数 74B、激活 9B，许可证为 OpenMDW-1.1，面向本地运行日常智能体任务（工具调用、网页浏览、终端操作）。架构为 Mamba-2–Transformer 混合 LatentMoE，配 C-RADIO v4-H 视觉编码器；24GB 版本采用原生 2-bit 量化，另有 GGUF 与 BF16 版本。输入文本、图像和视频，输出文本；上下文最长 256K tokens，提示与回复共享。推理通过聊天模板 enable_thinking 开关。未找到 NVIDIA 托管 API 端点或官方 token 价格。
